verdict.rationale: Per-institution health is a fair axis for an open-banking provider like TrueLayer, but the evidence pack contains nothing about institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, or error codes that separate bank-side failures from integration failures. The providers endpoint only shows which banks are supported, and payment-status webhooks report individual payment state; both are adjacent features, not institution health monitoring.

support.subject: As an ops lead, per-institution health is visible — documented institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, and error codes that distinguish a bank problem from my problem
